name: ffmpeg
description:
FFmpeg is the universal, open-source multimedia framework capable of decoding, encoding, transcoding, muxing, demuxing, streaming, filtering, and playing virtually any audio or video format.

Features:
- Complete multimedia toolset including the ffmpeg, ffprobe, and ffplay binaries
- Hardware-accelerated video decoding and encoding via VA-API, NVENC, and QuickSync
- Broad codec support including AV1, H.264, HEVC, VP9, AAC, FLAC, and Opus
- Powerful audio and video filtering pipeline for resizing, cropping, and color grading
- Comprehensive container support for MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV, and streaming protocols
